summary: Token-gated document vault: api-key uploads, share tokens, remote fetch, quota accounting.

defects.title: Share tokens come from a time-seeded Mersenne Twister
defects.description: make_share_token derives tokens from random.random() and the process seeds random with int(time.time()) at startup, so share tokens are predictable to anyone who can narrow down the start time.
defects.trigger: Request one share token, brute-force the startup-time seed, predict the next
defects.observed: The predicted token equals the token the server issues for the next share.

defects.anchor: for a, b in zip(provided, expected):
defects.title: Share-token comparison exits on the first mismatch
defects.description: token_matches compares character by character and returns on the first difference, so the comparison time leaks how many leading characters are correct.
defects.trigger: Microbenchmark the compare function with a first-char mismatch vs a last-char mismatch
defects.observed: A mismatch on the final character takes measurably longer than one on the first (ratio > 1.5).

defects.title: Fetch accepts any URL scheme including file://
defects.description: fetch_remote passes the user-supplied URL straight to urlopen with no scheme or host allowlist, so local files and loopback services are reachable.
defects.observed: The local file's contents are stored as a document and served back.

defects.title: Object-format uploads are unpickled
defects.description: decode_body runs pickle.loads on attacker-controlled bytes whenever meta.format is 'object', executing the payload's __reduce__ during upload.
defects.trigger: POST /upload with meta.format 'object' and a pickle whose __reduce__ runs os.system
defects.observed: The embedded command executes on the server during the upload.

defects.title: Admin purge only checks that the header is present
defects.description: purge gates on 'X-Admin-Key' being in the headers rather than its value, so any non-empty value authorizes wiping the vault.
defects.observed: All documents are deleted and usage counters reset.

defects.title: Quota check is separated from the usage update by the staged write
defects.description: save_upload checks used + len <= quota, then stages the payload to disk before updating usage; concurrent uploads all observe the same stale usage and together exceed the quota.
defects.trigger: 20 parallel uploads of QUOTA/4 bytes each
defects.observed: Many more than 4 uploads are accepted and stored although only 4 fit under the 64 KiB quota.

defects.title: Redirect target is used verbatim
defects.description: go copies the ?next= parameter into the Location header without validating the host or scheme.
defects.observed: HTTP 302 with Location pointing at the external URL.

defects.title: Document titles are rendered unescaped
defects.description: docs_html interpolates each title into the listing markup, so a title containing HTML is emitted raw.
defects.trigger: Upload a document titled '<script>alert(2)</script>' and GET /docs.html
defects.observed: The page contains the script tag verbatim.

defects.title: Staged upload files are never removed
defects.description: save_upload copies the staged .part file into the docs directory instead of moving it, so every upload leaves a full copy behind in DATA_DIR/tmp.
defects.observed: tmp/ accumulates one .part file per upload, mirroring the docs directory.

defects.title: Share TTL is not required to be positive
defects.description: share_expiry adds ttl_seconds without a lower bound, so a negative ttl mints a share that is already expired (and the expiry check treats it as dead).
defects.observed: A token is returned whose expires_at precedes its created_at.

defects.title: Reading a missing document dereferences None
defects.description: can_read indexes doc["owner"] before any existence check; an unknown id yields None and raises TypeError, producing a 500 instead of a 404.
defects.observed: HTTP 500 for an unknown document id.
